name: opcua-attrpair
instr:
**Line gateway keeps resubscribing to stopped lines: "empty NotificationMessage"**

Our line gateway (gopcua client) watches each production line's tags on its Siemens S7-1500
through a NodeMonitor subscription with a 500 ms publishing interval. Anything that reaches the
monitor's error handler counts as a lost connection, so the gateway rebuilds the subscription.

On a stopped line, where nothing changes for a while, the error handler gets
`opcua: empty NotificationMessage` every five seconds or so, and the gateway resubscribes all
night. Changed values still come through fine.

In CI the gateway runs against a test server built on gopcua's own server package, with a
simulated line left idle for hours. It has never reported that error there, which is why it took
us a while to notice.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file in the package it exercises (say
./repro_test.go), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test failure,
not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix
